title: From workload shape to a hardware hypothesis
caption: The operation mix identifies candidate execution units, and the operand path determines whether those units can stay busy.

title: Execution paths in a projection and softmax
caption: Time spent in reductions, exponentials, and normalization can dominate even when the projection keeps the matrix engine busy.

title: Follow a tensor across memory interfaces
caption: Each crossing has its own byte count and bandwidth, so a saturated host link and a saturated device-memory interface call for different changes.

title: Modeled ceilings for the same kernel
caption: At the assumed intensity of 4 FLOP/byte, doubling bandwidth raises the roofline ceiling while doubling only the arithmetic peak leaves it unchanged.

title: Baseline tile storage
caption: The four allocations sum to 116 KiB. The baseline exceeds the 96 KiB SRAM limit by 20 KiB, even though its operand buffers fit by themselves.

title: Compare schedules for the same tensor operation
caption: Capacity establishes which schedules can run. Traffic estimates and profiling reveal whether their reuse improves elapsed time.

title: From graph optimization to a running request
caption: The compiled plan describes available execution paths. The runtime trace shows which path a particular request took and where it waited.

title: Evaluate a partition across devices
caption: A partition improves request latency only when the computation it removes from the critical path outweighs the communication and waiting it adds there.

title: Evaluate a heterogeneous pipeline in steady operation
caption: Engine support and handoff costs determine the executable mapping, while a sustained run reveals whether it keeps meeting the deadline.

title: From workload requirements to procurement
caption: Reject candidates that miss service requirements before ranking the feasible platforms by the cost and energy of delivering useful work.
